items.title: Dick Griffin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 12, 2024
items.q: this one of my friends named Johnny Grimes, he told me there’s three types of people in the world.

ctx.x: That kind of empathy and character it seems has stayed with you. Do you believe it’s found its way into your composing and your visual artwork?

Oh sure, yeah. More and more now, like I say the older I get the more I really refer back to what my mother taught me and how it’s better to give and it’s kind of unpopular to be counting now, because people take advantage of that, you know take kindness as a weakness. They were — you know if you give them something people think they’re getting over on you, they’re thinking oh everybody — not everybody but a lot of people are hustling and trying to take as much as — there’s three types of people — this one of my…
Do you do anything on purpose to inspire yourself for new compositions or new visual arts? If you’re staring at a blank canvas what compels you to start?
